name: Molecule
description: A ball-and-stick model spread over the sheet: colored balls of every size joined to their neighbors by dark sticks, across, down and on the slant.

code.style: --rule: ( --d: @r(26%, 56%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --k: @p(@var(--k0), @var(--k1), @var(--k2), @var(--k3), @var(--k4), @var(--k5), @var(--k6), @var(--k7), @var(--k8)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--k); clip-path: @var(--k); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: @var(--d); height: @var(--d); left: calc(50% - @var(--d) / 2); top: calc(50% - @var(--d) / 2); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
